# EDBB documentation voice and structure

Gerhard's direction, 28 September 2026: use EDIS Global's tone and voice. There is no requirement to invent different wording for a shared policy or procedure.

- Explain the answer directly, then give the steps and expected result. Use ordinary customer language: server, operating system, password, invoice and control panel.
- Reuse a clear EDIS explanation where the behaviour is identical. Adapt EDBB panel labels, screenshots, links, legal identity, plans and commercial details carefully.
- Preserve useful detail. A short caution or instruction to contact support does not replace a procedure that customers can complete themselves.
- Keep exact EDBB menu/button labels. Use Steps for sequential work, Tabs for real OS differences, Frames for existing screenshots, and tables for comparisons. Do not put every paragraph in a callout or hide essential instructions in accordions.
- State destructive consequences immediately before the action. Include verification and recovery instructions, without making every introduction an internal safety checklist.
- Keep internal source comparisons, verification notes and implementation instructions in review files. Customers do not need to be told not to copy EDIS prices or that a link is intentional.
- Keep working published URLs and redirects. When changing headings, preserve important old section links beside the replacement section.
- Match titles, descriptions and sidebar labels to the customer's task. Do not shorten a page by deleting its answer.

## Fixed EDBB distinctions

ED Backbone & Co in Cyprus operates EDBB. EDBB uses its own plans, globally uniform prices and my.edbb.com panel. It offers no account/order API, BYOIP or commercial /24 product, and no volume-discount or decided reseller programme. Support is support@edbb.com; abuse is abuse@edbb.com. Shared status.edis.global links are intentional. Keep the EDBB bank PDF.

Billing, refunds, traffic mechanics, locations, OS inventory and service policies follow the agreed shared backend rules. Plan allowances come from EDBB plans.

**Annual 11+1 purchases use a coupon and are excluded from refunds.** This was explicitly confirmed by Gerhard. Keep the exclusion alongside annual-offer explanations as well as in the full refund policy.
